deals.comment: Nzin Corp. acquired remaining 47.6% stake in Zinny Labs Corporation from a group of individuals for CNY 4.8 million on April 29, 2016. Under the terms of the deal, 9,520 shares are acquired at an offer per share of KRW 500.

deals.target: Kakao Corp., Game Publishing Business and Others in the Game Business Segment
deals.comment: Kakao Games Corporation agreed to acquire game publishing business and others in the game business segment from Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) for approximately KRW 220 billion on August 16, 2017. As consideration, Kakao Games Corporation will issue 0.03 million shares to Kakao Corp. The transaction requires submission of Fair Trade Commission report and was resolved by the Board of Kakao Corp. on August 16, 2017. Expected date of the general meeting of shareholders is September 19, 2017 and the transaction is expected to close on November 1, 2017.

Kakao Games Corporation agreed to acquire Maum Golf Co., Ltd. for KRW 10.9 million on September 25, 2017. Under the terms of transaction, Kakao Games Corporation will issue 5042 new shares for Maum Golf Co., Ltd. shares for KRW 7.4 million each and will acquire 1.5 million shares. For the year ended December 31, 2016, Maum Golf Co., Ltd. reported total assets of KRW 11.1 billion and net assets of KRW 1.3 billion. The transaction is subject to approval from shareholders of Kakao Games Corporation. The Board of Kakao Games Corporation resolved the transaction. The transaction is expected to be completed by November 28, 2017. The proceeds from the transaction will be used to acquire other company’s securities.

Kakao VX Inc. agreed to acquire 55% stake in Gaseung Development Co., Ltd. for KRW 7.8 billion on November 9, 2020. Kakao VX Inc. will acquire 0.11 million shares. Kakao VX Inc. For the year ended 2019 Gaseung Development Co., Ltd. has total assets of KRW 15.2 billion, total equity of KRW 9.1 billion and net loss of KRW 465 million  Board of Kakao VX Inc. resolved transaction on November 09, 2020. Expected acquisition date is November 20, 2020.

Double Tree Asset Co., Ltd. acquired 50% in Gaseung Development Co., Ltd. from NXC Corporation for KRW 6 billion on November 12, 2020. As per terms, 0.1 million shares are acquired at KRW 0.06 million per share. Post completion, NXC Corporation has exited from Gaseung Development.

Kakao VX Inc. acquired additional 5% stake in Gaseung Development Co., Ltd. for KRW 1.8 billion on February 16, 2021. As part of the transaction, Kakao VX Inc. purchased additional 5% stake in Gaseung Development. Now, Kakao VX holds 55% stake in Gaseung Development Co., Ltd.
